learning_outcomes.text: Master manufacturing processes and systems, including metrology and quality evaluation systems used in Engineering.
Know the main non-conventional manufacturing processes.
Express and communicate ideas and systems related to manufacturing systems and processes, as well as materials technology.
Master calculations and estimation and design procedures in matters of materials, production, and manufacturing.

syllabus_topics: Metrology: Measurement of threads and gears.
Fundamentals of plastic deformation forming processes.
Fundamental aspects of numerical control machine tools.
Programming of numerical control machine tools.
Penetration and wire electrical discharge machining (EDM).
Water jet machining with and without abrasives.
Applications of plasma in manufacturing processes.
assessment_rules: The final grade is the weighted arithmetic average of all evaluated activities. A minimum score of 4.5 out of 10 is required for the exam. If the exam score is below 4.5 and the weighted average is 5.0 or higher, the final grade will be 4.9. If a student does not attend the exam, the grade will be "No presentado". Works, oral presentations, and practical class attendance/guide delivery are not recoverable activities.
